//: A one-person content business. Copy to ../org.config.json and edit the roots.

departments.name: Growth
departments.mission: Turn what you learn into posts, and posts into an audience that trusts you enough to buy.
departments.note: Read the lane ledger before producing anything in that lane. That single habit is why run ten beats run one.

items.label: trend-scan
items.desc: Finds what people are actually talking about this month.

items.label: competitor-pull
items.desc: Scrapes engagement on your own posts and a peer set.

items.label: draft
items.desc: Writes the post in your voice, not a generic one.

items.label: script
items.desc: No skill for short-form video scripts, which is the format posted most often. Every script starts cold.

items.label: what-works
items.desc: Running record of the formats and hooks that land. Read before proposing anything.

items.label: post-retro
items.desc: Nothing writes a retro after a post lands, so the loop closes by hand or not at all.

departments.name: Revenue
departments.mission: Convert attention into paid members, courses and products.
departments.note: Name the step in your funnel you cannot measure. Knowing where the blind spot is beats pretending there is none.

items.label: money-map
items.desc: The funnel and the offers in one file. Ground every pricing answer here.

items.label: pricing-test
items.desc: No structured pricing experiment has been run.

items.label: dm-to-sale
items.desc: Nothing tracks a conversation through to a purchase, so conversion is unknown.

departments.name: Labs
departments.mission: Build the tooling the other departments run on.
departments.note: The friction queue from every other department lands here. That combined list is the build queue.

items.label: usage-audit
items.desc: No record of which installed skills have ever run, so the list cannot be pruned honestly.

departments.name: Memory
departments.mission: Hold what the other departments need to remember, and hand it back on demand.
departments.note: This ledger records changes to how the vault is organised, not the content going into it.

items.label: search-order
items.desc: Project folder first, knowledge second, archive never unless asked. This is why exact search keeps working.

items.label: vault-mcp
items.desc: Reads and writes the vault directly.

items.label: weekly-digest
items.desc: Nothing summarises what the vault learned this week.

departments.name: Self
departments.mission: Keep the operator running. There is one, and everything routes through them.
departments.note: When several ledgers have a bad week at once, check this one before looking for a process fix.

items.label: weekly-review
items.desc: Nothing connects a week of poor output to its cause.
